updates.label: Which game?

faq.a: Yes. It is a free fan-made browser brawler by Fl3xix, and guest play needs no account. This site loads the original from pokeversus.com when you click Play.

faq.q: Do I need an account to play PokéVersus?
faq.a: No. The login window offers Play as guest. A guest keeps progress only in that browser; a Google or email account stores progress in the cloud for use on any device.

faq.q: Which starter Pokémon can I pick in PokéVersus?
faq.a: Three, one of each type. Grass, Fire and Water offer nine starters each, 27 in total, from Bulbasaur, Charmander and Squirtle to Sprigatito, Fuecoco and Quaxly. All three evolve during matches.

faq.q: What is Toxic Fog in PokéVersus?
faq.a: A free-for-all for 10 players, Solo or Duo. You break crates for Rare Candies while the toxic fog closes in, and the last one standing wins.

faq.q: Is PokéVersus the same game as Pokeverse?
faq.a: No. Pokeverse at pokeverse.quest advertises a separate Pokémon MMORPG with its own clients, and the PokéCommunity “PokeVersus!” thread is an unrelated forum vote.

faq.q: Can I play PokéVersus on a phone?
faq.a: The client shows touch controls with a landscape prompt on phones. The menus were checked at phone width in a desktop browser, not on a physical phone.
